title: The committed bootstrap no longer routes every task through a lane
summary: The block ia host --commit writes says reading, building, testing, editing and submitting a change need no binding, plugin, door or private access, routes through the lanes only when a task needs a method, and says an operation that needs a bound method or private authority refuses alone. It ends with a one-line ia-bootstrap marker, and names CONTRIBUTING.md when the repository has a plain file of that name; a directory, link or oversized file there never fails the command. The block is written using the instruction file's first LF or CRLF line ending (or LF if neither occurs), and a block the earlier text wrote is updated in place the same way, including any existing closing line break; an existing block at the end of a file with no final line break keeps none.
